name: Quick Heal Technologies Ltd
about: Quick Heal Technologies is engaged in the business of providing security software products. The Company caters to both domestic and international market.
keyPoints:
Market Share 
It is a leader in the cybersecurity enterprise solutions space in India, with over 30% market share. [1] In FY24, the company became the only Indian cybersecurity firm listed as a U.S. Artificial Intelligence Safety Institute Consortium Member. [2]

cons: Stock is trading at 3.68 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -0.47% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.89% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.20.6 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 218 days.
